definitions.gloss: crude drug; herbal medicine ingredient; natural medicinal material
definitions.explanation: Natural substances — typically plants, but also minerals and animal products — used as ingredients in traditional medicine, especially in kampo (漢方). These are the raw or minimally processed materials from which medicines are prepared.

examples.japanese: {生薬|しょうやく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{煎|せん}じて→煎じる：27815_senjiru⟧⟦{飲|の}む→飲む：00322_nomu⟧。
examples.english: To brew and drink herbal medicine.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{漢方薬|かんぽうやく}→漢方薬：17468_kanpouyaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{複数|ふくすう}→複数：14236_fukusuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{生薬|しょうやく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{配合|はいごう}→配合：16196_haigou⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: This kampo medicine is a blend of multiple herbal ingredients.

examples.japanese: {高麗|こうらい}⟦{人参|にんじん}→人参：05185_ninjin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{古|ふる}く→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{貴重|きちょう}→貴重：00223_kichou⟧な{生薬|しょうやく}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧{珍重|ちんちょう}⟦されて→する：00392_suru⟧きた。
examples.english: Korean ginseng has been valued as a precious herbal medicine ingredient since ancient times.

notes:
PRONUNCIATION:
Also read as きぐ⟦すり→すり：01330_suri⟧, but しょうやく is the standard reading in medical and pharmaceutical contexts.

USAGE:
A technical term in traditional medicine, pharmacology, and kampo. Commonly encountered in product labels for herbal medicines and health supplements.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {生薬|しょうやく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{配合|はいごう}→配合：16196_haigou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to blend herbal ingredients)
- {生薬|しょうやく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{煎|せん}じる→煎じる：27815_senjiru⟧ (to brew herbal medicine)
- ⟦{天然|てんねん}→天然：03560_tennen⟧{生薬|しょうやく} (natural herbal ingredients)
